data.text:
Indresh Prasad, Food Safety Officer vs State Of U.P. And 3
Others on 8 November, 2024 
Author: Neeraj Tiwari
Bench: Neeraj Tiwari
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:175357
Court No. - 7
Case :- Writ - A No. - 13601 of 2024
Petitioner :- Indresh Prasad, Food Safety Officer
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Prabhakar Awasthi,Ram Chandra Kushwaha 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Neeraj Tiwari,J.
1.  Heard learned counsel for petitioner and learned standing counsel for State-respondents. 
2. Learned counsel for petitioner submitted that petitioner was posted as Food Safety Officer at Gorakhpur vide order dated 27.06.2022, thereafter he has been transferred to Basti Division and submitted his joining there on 08.07.2022. Prior to petitioner, Mr. Seraj Ahmad was posted as Food Safety Officer at Basti Division. Vide order dated 30.07.2024, Mr. Seraj Ahmad was placed under suspension on the ground that he has not handed over the papers of certain samples collected by him to the petitioner and surprisingly, vide same order date, petitioner has also been placed under suspension on the ground that he has not taken any action on the relevant papers. He further Indresh Prasad, Food Safety Officer vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149892336/
1 submitted that vide letter dated 30.07.2024, Mr. Seraj Ahmad himself has handed over the relevant papers to the Assistant Commissioner, Food Safety & Drug Administration, U.P. at Lucknow, but even though, vide impugned order dated 30.07.2024, petitioner has also been placed under suspension on the ground that he has not taken necessary action on the relevant papers. On one hand, papers have not been handed over to the petitioner and on other hand, on the very same date i.e. 30.07.2024, petitioner has been placed under suspension. He further submitted that petitioner has received charge sheet dated 05.09.2024 on 11.09.2024 and also submitted his reply but till date inquiry has not been completed. Lastly, submitted that under such facts, impugned order is bad and liable to be quashed. 
3. Learned standing counsel could not dispute the aforesaid facts. 
4. I have considered submissions advanced by learned counsels for parties and perused the records. 
5. From perusal, it is apparently clear that argument so made by learned counsel for petitioner is getting full support from the papers annexed along with writ petition. 
6. Therefore, under such facts, impugned order dated 30.07.2024 is hereby quashed. 
7. Writ petition is allowed. No order as to costs. 
8. As in the present case, petitioner has already submitted reply of charge sheet, therefore,
Disciplinary Authority is directed to complete inquiry as well as disciplinary proceedings, maximum within a period of eight weeks from the date of production of certified copy of this order. Petitioner is also directed to extend his full cooperation in inquiry proceedings. 
Order Date :- 8.11.2024 Sartaj  Indresh Prasad, Food Safety Officer vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149892336/
